notes: Judgment calls, not failures. wrong_crop-001 (grape early blight) and -002 (apple early blight): the grape docs list Alternaria rot and leaf blight, and the apple docs cover Alternaria blotch, so a reader may find these slightly closer than the other traps. Early blight (Alternaria solani) is a distinct disease and does not appear in those crops' documents. wrong_crop-010 (apple, Diplocarpon earliana): the apple docs mention Marssonina leaf blotch, which is a different Diplocarpon species, but the trap term 'diplocarpon' is absent from the apple docs. wrong_crop-023 (corn, cedar apple rust): corn docs cover common and southern rust, not cedar apple rust. The trap tests use a word-start regex on a few terms per question, so they cannot catch a synonym. My manual sweep found none. No LLM or GPU use; nothing written under legacy/.
